doc.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022

title: Opening and introduction
summary: Monk Rowe introduces the interview and Tiberi modestly accepts the congratulations.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m pleased to have Frank Tiberi with me today. And I want to congratulate you on your lengthy and productive career.

Well I appreciate you having me and I feel very interesting actually — just as a person of interest I suppose you know. I mean I’ve gone through many, many years and I don’t really think that I can really provide anything for anyone but we’ll see.
